svg.title: yak build time constants
svg.desc: A Container takes its padding and a media query from constants.yak.ts. At build time, yak runs that file, calculates the values and writes them into the CSS, and the component works like a plain div with a class name. In the browser, the media query switches the padding without any JavaScript.

g.text: yak writes the values into the CSS
The build runs constants.yak.ts and writes the results.
No constants ship to the browser
The media query switches the padding. No JavaScript runs.
